en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small railway station building with a gabled metal roof and a sign reading "JÄRNFORSEN" above the entrance. Train tracks run along the foreground. Behind and beside the station are residential-style buildings with similar roofs and trees in front. In the upper right corner of the image is printed text that labels the view as the railway station of Järnforsen, in a serif font typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
